name: Hende Tomoru
source: Tomoru is an ordinary guy, very carefree who doesn't take everything too serious. He likes boobs and has a bad habit of staring at heroine's chests getting him into trouble most of the time, despite all of this he's clever and kind jumping to help those who are in trouble.
